# 打印错误码 / Print error codes · 12

[返回索引 / Index](../../PRINT-ERROR-CODES.md) | [故障码说明 / Guide](../../ERROR-CODES.md)

同码可能因机型不同而有不同文案。来源和原始变体见 `docs/data/error-codes.json`。 Model-specific descriptions and source variants are preserved in that data file.

| `0x12004001` | 检测到禁用AMS时仍从AMS加载料，请将耗材退回AMS并从料盘支架加载新料后重新发起打印。 | Filament is still loaded from the AMS when it has been disabled. Please unload AMS filament, load from spool holder, and restart print job. |
| `0x12008001` | 切料失败，请查看切刀是否卡住。可查看助手了解具体原因和解决方法。 | Cutting the filament failed. Please check to see if the cutter is stuck. Refer to the Assistant for solutions. |
